poseScope: supplied in-memory pose; CLI creates registered factory default, physics=false, no animation advance
limitations: No live browser state, pixels, texture colors or GPU-only displacement.
Bone normals use Babylon CPU palette semantics; no geometric surface repair.

meshes.name: head
meshes.matrixConvention: column-major; source-local coordinates to output-world coordinates
meshes.normalConvention: Babylon current morph/skin normals; inverse-transpose instance world; normalized; output Z reflection
meshes.colorConvention: raw vertex RGB (no gamma conversion, material multiplication or texture sampling); alpha separate
